what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as viewer.audit. Clicked the magnifier icon in the top bar, typed 'tile', and got one result under TASKS: 'Order tiles for master bath' (Kapoor Villa (Audit), open). Clicking it showed a 'Quick look' panel; its Open button just closed the panel and left me on Home with no visible navigation. I then went to Projects > Tasks and found the same task in the Task register (assigned to Arjun Architect, due 2026-12-05, status Open). No other tile-related items were shown.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: Quick look 'Open' button went nowhere visible; had to go via Projects > Tasks manually
unnecessary_steps: Search result click opens an intermediate Quick look panel before anything useful
confusing_terminology: Quick look -> unclear it is only a preview
Open -> implies opening the item but only closed the panel
'Changes appear after review and approval' on the task register is unexplained for a viewer
missing_feedback: No feedback or page change after pressing Open in Quick look
Search shows no result count and no 'nothing else found' statement
unexpected_behaviour: Open in Quick look returned to Home instead of the task
visual_issues: Quick look panel has large empty space and shows no task details (owner, due date)
Project card on Projects page has a lot of empty space
accessibility_issues: Search and other top-bar controls are icon-only with no visible text labels
Keyboard use not tested beyond Enter at sign-in
observations: Global search is easy to spot and returns results as you type, with a clear 'Searching everything you can see' hint matching the viewer scope. The broken Open handoff is the main flaw. Documents tab was not checked separately; search showed no document matches.

rating_justifications.system_feedback: Pressing Open in Quick look closed the panel and left me on Home with no message or navigation.
